cl.x: Provide Sikalastic®-777 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: Surface must be clean, sound, smooth and dust-free as well as oil-free. In the case of a high porosity substrate, it is recommended to use an epoxy primer. Please see 'priming' section below for further information.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.

s: Curing time: 24 hours for full cure.
Drying time: Sikalastic®-777 can be subject to light foot traffic after 24 hours.
r: Sikalastic®-777 can be subject to light foot traffic after 24 hours.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information > Dry film thickness
cl.x: Vertical applications: 2 coats of a minimum of 0.670 litres (670 micron) /m2 each are required to achieve a 1 mm dry film thickness. Floor applications: 2 coats of a minimum of 0.8 litre (800 micron) /m2 each are required to achieve a 1.2 mm dry film thickness. Minimum 1-1.2mm DFT recommended on all applications.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information > Waiting time to overcoating
cl.x: In normal conditions, Sikalastic®-777 can be recoated with another layer of Sikalastic®-777 after one night and within 2 days. In case of rain or if the recoating interval was exceeded, light abrasion and reactivate Sikalastic®- 777 with Sika Thinner C or for the best results remove the existing coating back to substrate and re-apply.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Reusable tools should be cleaned carefully with Sika Thinner C before curing.

s: Do not install Sikalastic®-777 without the use of a primer.
Do not under apply Sikalastic®-777 as this will impact the products performance, UV resistance and cause premature degradation.
